champions.tldr: Innate: Aurora's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target con…
champions.gameplayImpact: Aurora was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Aurora's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage equal to 4% , capped at 90+10*x against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Upon consuming the stacks from a champion, Aurora additionally exorcises them, gaining Realm Hopper for 4 seconds and freeing a Spirit|buzzword from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active Spirit|buzzword, Aurora heal for 3–20 (+ 2% AP) every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further Spirits|buzzword and refresh the duration of Realm Hopper and all active Spirits|buzzword. Aurora may have up to 4 Spirits|buzzword at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of 12–80 (+ 8% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Realm Hopper: Aurora gains ghosting and ms|5 + 0.25*(x-1)% (+ 3% per 100 AP) (+ 5–20%)|buzzword bonus movement speed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Aurora fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals 40–140 (+ 40% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and marks them with a curse for 3.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Twofold Hex can be recast after 0.5 seconds of marking at least one target.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Aurora expunges the curse from all marked targets, drawing the spiritual energy back to her as bolts that each deal the same magic damage to all enemies they pass through, reduced to 50% against minions and monsters and increased by 0–100% (over 0–100). Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal 20% damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Aurora dash in the target direction inside a portal to the Spirit Realm. Upon completing the dash, she becomes invisible for 1–1.6 seconds and gains Spirit Abjuration|Realm Hopper}} for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends the stealth immediately.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them resets Across the Veil's cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Aurora blasts energy in a line in the target direction and dash 250 units in the opposite direction. The blast deals 70–230 (+ 80% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and slow them by 80% for 1 second decaying after 0.15 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Aurora dash in the target direction with displacement immunity while unleashing a pulse of energy at a set location in front of her, both over 0.5 seconds. She then gains Spirit Abjuration|Realm Hopper}} for 4 seconds and the pulse expands in a radius from the location over the next 0.75 seconds, dealing 250–500 (3 ranks) (+ 65% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Once the pulse has fully expanded, it manifests a circular rift to the Spirit Realm for 3–4 (3 ranks) seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: While Aurora is inside the rift, she doubles the bonus movement speed granted by Spirit Abjuration|Realm Hopper}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Aurora and enemies within the rift are trapped inside. If Aurora collides with the border, she dash to the diametrically opposite side of the rift over 0.4 seconds, becoming untargetable and lockout during the travel. If an enemy collides with the border, they are airborne 75 units away from it and are slow by 75% for 2 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Between Worlds can be recast after 1 second of unleashing the pulse.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Aurora closes the rift prematurely.
